name: luxury-cruise-satin-gown-goddess
image_purpose: Luxury travel and evening fashion social content

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic nighttime portrait on a modern balcony overlooking a harbor and illuminated luxury cruise ship.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with fair skin, light eyes, natural brows, subtle makeup, muted rose lipstick, and long soft platinum-blonde waves with individual strands visible. She wears a form-fitting sleeveless nude-beige satin dress with thin straps and natural folds, holding a small silver crystal clutch; her expression is calm and confident with a relaxed gaze.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical portrait from full-body to mid-length at eye level. Place the woman on a high-rise balcony with one hand raised near her shoulder, potted plants and railing in the foreground, and a large illuminated luxury cruise ship, city lights and buildings softly out of focus behind her.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Mixed cinematic lighting: warm balcony light on skin with cool ship and city lights in the background, natural shadows under chin and arms, smooth falloff, quiet premium harbor atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic vertical fashion-lifestyle portrait, full-frame camera with 85mm f/1.8 lens, shallow depth of field, ultra-sharp subject, true-to-life color grading, realistic satin highlights and skin texture, subtle 35mm grain, no watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic nighttime portrait of one generic approved adult woman with fair skin, long soft platinum-blonde hair in loose natural waves, light eyes, natural brows, subtle eye makeup and muted rose lipstick, standing on a modern high-rise balcony overlooking a harbor. She wears a form-fitting sleeveless nude-beige satin dress with thin straps and natural folds, holds a small silver crystal clutch, and raises one hand near her shoulder in a relaxed graceful pose.
